about.description: Single-stock perpetual market tracking Ciena Corporation (CIEN) on Paragon. Users get linear exposure to CIEN share-price moves without owning CIEN shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims. HIP-3 builder-deployed market on Hyperliquid in the para namespace, cash-settled in USDC. Equity marks are sourced from Pyth equity feeds during covered sessions and bounded internally off-hours.
